_about: The one place that says how a low-risk Claude call is served when the Claude pool is exhausted (T14/T15). Read by bin/escalate.sh and bin/omniroute-run.sh; check it with `bin/omniroute-run.sh --check`. Changing a provider, model, fallback order or list is an edit of this file plus `bin/omniroute-run-selftest.sh`; no code names a model or provider. Model names are whatever the gateway accepts (its provider picker); the entry below is only an example: use whatever the gateway's /v1/models lists for the provider you picked. Turning `enabled` on needs a non-empty providers.allow (the runner refuses otherwise); the gateway's install folder (install_dir) is how the runner knows the process on its port is the real one.
